hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Evaluate candidate monetary values monotonically to count how many multiples of coin denominations exist less than or equal to candidate x.

hints.title: Inclusion-Exclusion Principle
hints.text: Since coin count is at most 15, calculate the least common multiple for all non-empty subsets of coins to count unique multiples accurately.

hints.title: Monotonic Search
hints.text: Range from one to minimum coin times k. If count of multiples is at least k, record candidate and search left, else search right.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Precomputing subset least common multiples followed by binary search.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Heap simulation with up to k = 2 * 10^9 takes infeasible time and memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combine inclusion-exclusion principle over small subsets with binary search on the answer.
